name: cloudflared-hub
docker_compose_raw:
services:
  cloudflared:
    container_name: cloudflare-tunnel
    image: 'cloudflare/cloudflared:latest'
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: 'tunnel --no-autoupdate run'
    environment:
      - 'TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - cloudflared
        - '--version'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
